title: A Telegram photo shows the preview inside its message until its thumbnail lands

not_applicable.macos: The check reads screen pixels. The macOS lab's helper reads window text only, and teaching it to save a picture rebuilds the ad hoc signed helper, which drops its Screen Recording grant. The tile code it draws is the same on every desktop.
